examples.title: Example 1: Setting a Sticky Header and Footer
examples.description:
This example uses sticky to implement the sticky header and footer.
ListDataSource implements the LazyForEach data source API IDataSource, which is used to provide child components for List and ListItemGroup through LazyForEach.

examples.title: Example 2: Applying a Card-style Effect
examples.description: This example illustrates the card-style effect of the ListItemGroup component.

examples.title: Example 3: Setting Header and Footer
examples.description:
This example uses ComponentContent to set the header and footer.
For details about ListDataSource and the complete code, see Example 1: Setting a Sticky Header and Footer.

examples.title: Example 4: Setting a Multi-Column Layout
examples.description:
This example shows how to use ListItemGroup in a multi-column layout. The lanes attribute of the List component is set to implement the multi-column layout.
For details about ListDataSource and the complete code, see Example 1: Setting a Sticky Header and Footer.
